scripts.dev: npm run db:start && concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @stocksense/api" "npm run dev -w @stocksense/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stocksense/api && npm run build -w @stocksense/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @stocksense/api && npm run typecheck -w @stocksense/web
